checks: Original HIF callback copy and CE receive route feed original HP adapter and production unmap parser; 192 inherited composite selections retained
Original HTC stop executes both RX_SG_SUPPORT branches, endpoint RX/TX flushes and polled timer order before original multibus HIF stop delegate, then native endpoint reset
32 stop contracts cover SG on/off, WDI on/off, polled/nonpolled HTT lookup policy, v1/v2 and alignment; a final model-admitted message is consumed during lower stop while context is retained
8 CE contracts cover bounded packet length, zero/short unmap and oversize free ownership; 12 new mutations plus 82 prior controls rejected
Retained HTC/HIF callback pointers are explicitly observed after stop; post-stop admission closure and release are model assumptions, not callback revocation
new_model.limitations: No production patch added. HIF copy uses the source QCN9224 16-pipe bound with modeled layouts, not phone feature selection. Real CE rings, DMA, interrupts, locks, timers, queue flushes and bus stop synchronization are not executed. Lower bus stop is a serial model admission barrier; no real concurrent producer, stale-pointer invocation, registration reentrancy, physical HTT free, production shutdown coordinator, SSR, phone/RF or AirDrop validation. HTC endpoint reset does not clear captured receive callback/context pointers. Native generic dispatcher remains consumed-prefix only. Backend stays disabled.

checks: original HTT constructor, HTC attach, send-full handler, HIF HP packet adapter and both original WDI registration variants execute with modeled lower connect/store endpoints
captured native registration callback/context pairs carry ordinary HTC or HIF HP messages through the original consumed-entry prefix into the production parser and native DP peer/VDEV release chain

192 composite selections and 64 constructor/registration/delivery contracts cover WDI on/off, v1/v2, aligned/unaligned buffers, response endpoint, transport failure/cancel, null packet/context/buffer and failed connect
68 inherited controls retain the preceding direct-parser path; 13 new mutations and one unmodified native wrong-pipe rejection pass
native-htt-callbacks.limitations: Fixture-injected HTC/HIF deliveries, not real service, DMA/bus/interrupt or firmware events. Original generic dispatcher prefix executes only until the production unmap consumer returns; unconsumed generic tail is an abort stub, with narrow unused-local warnings suppressed only around this extracted prefix. WDI-enabled and disabled source variants are tested explicitly, not a claim of phone feature selection. Lower HTC connect, endpoint save, logging init, HIF store, handles and layouts remain models; no real attach-time reentrancy, teardown, deregistration or late-producer race validation. Prior DP construction/reference/peer-gone/platform and cleanup endpoints remain models. Original TX completion is an abort endpoint; send-full KEEP only is exercised. No backend activation, automatic parent shutdown, active SSR, phone/RF or AirDrop certification.

checks: production patch installs a length-checked HTT unmap consumer before generic packet-context/header reads, preserving non-unmap caller ownership and unselected switch arms

production helper and original deswizzle execute with original wire enum/GET macros; independent encoder tests v1 four-byte and v2 twenty-byte consumed prefixes, optional trailing bytes, unaligned data and both deswizzle source branches

168 composite selections deliver through production parser into native lookup/map removal/unmap/peer and VDEV finalizers; 303 parser contracts include all lengths 0..36, transport failure/cancel, borrowed unknown type, null packet/context/data/buffer
56 inherited controls retain old unmap route; 12 parser mutations rejected; checked trampoline forwards production runtime completion after actual host DP storage frees
native-htt-unmap.limitations: Production parser helper executes from modeled HTC packet/nbuf delivery; full generic dispatcher and actual HTC/HIF service registration/firmware transport are source-reviewed/compiled, not executed in host fixture. Nbuf storage is host heap, atomics/locks/maps, initial reference graph and DP cleanup/event/AST/flow/statistics endpoints remain models. BIG_ENDIAN_HOST probe executes its source branch on a little-endian host with modeled host-word MAC swizzling, not a real big-endian platform. No general validation of other HTT message formats, no firmware delivery/concurrency, production parent shutdown coordinator, active SSR, phone/RF or AirDrop certification. Backend remains disabled.

original map removal returns its own CONFIG reference separately from the final unmap CONFIG put; lookup acquires a temporary HTT pin through original nonzero-ref admission
invalid/out-of-range and duplicate IDs return without stale peer access; zero-ref lookup admission and WDS offload skip/AST-present/AST-absent paths preserve CONFIG and mapping
original non-WDS unmap records event/Qref/map invalidation/state, drops HTT then lifecycle CONFIG and reaches actual host peer/VDEV frees and production runtime completion
46 inherited controls execute with previous modeled unmap route; ten new mutations exercise native lookup/map/unmap path
native-dp-unmap.limitations: Native handler C execution from fixture calls, not real firmware delivery. DP construction, initial lifecycle/map/CHILD reference acquisition, map array and platform atomics/locks, event/Qref/AST/flow/IPA/WDI/OL/partner/statistics endpoints, peer-gone gate and release scheduling remain deterministic models. Map lookup/ref acquisition and removal functions are original, but peer create/map-add/delete, firmware HTT parser/transport and RX event registration do not execute. WDS AST helpers are models; STA cache branch and multi-soc/MLO ownership are unselected. DP and ObjMgr peer remain separate; no production bridge/concurrent late producer safety is certified. Prior component/shutdown boundaries remain; host heap free is not kernel allocator execution. No backend activation, active SSR, phone/RF or AirDrop certification.

native-dp-peer-free.limitations: Native peer final free and VDEV final free only. DP peer/VDEV construction, initial CONFIG/HTT/TX/RX/CHILD reference acquisition, mapping invalidation, peer-gone gate and release scheduling remain fixture models. The firmware dp_rx_peer_unmap_handler and DP peer create/delete/find-map APIs are not executed. DP peer and ObjMgr peer are distinct objects; their simulated ordering is not a verified production bridge. AST begins empty; SAWF, minidump, state, peer cleanup, monitor/txrx detach, list/lock/atomic endpoints remain models. Heap storage is actually freed on host under sanitizers, not by the kernel allocator. Inherited PSOC/PDEV components and shutdown coordinator remain modeled or absent; no real concurrency, firmware/phone/RF, active SSR, backend activation or AirDrop certification.

native-dp-vdev-free.limitations: Native DP finalizer only. DP allocation, attach/detach admission and callback registration, initial CONFIG/CHILD/HTT ref acquisition, peer-gone gate and late HTT release are fixture models. DP cleanup endpoints, list/lock/atomic implementations and optional notification are modeled; no native DP peer unmap/ref-delete, real datapath component cleanup, firmware, asynchronous producer or kernel concurrency. Callback trampoline invokes the existing production runtime completion after actual host heap free, not kernel allocator free. Inherited PSOC/PDEV/ObjMgr constructors, component registries and shutdown coordinator remain modeled or absent. PASSTHRU selected; monitor route excluded. No production backend activation or AirDrop certification.

native PSOC free invokes modeled global detach, native peer-list deinit with all 64 empty modeled lists and its modeled lock destruction, final PSOC lock destruction, then actual host heap free

native-psoc-free.limitations: Fixture caller integration only, no production shutdown coordinator. PSOC/PDEV allocation and initialization, component registry/two sentinel handlers, global PSOC registration/detach, peer hash lists, atomics and locks remain deterministic models. Native PSOC/PDEV create, actual PSOC peer/VDEV reference graph, real component implementations, real DP unmap/completion callbacks, Linux kworker concurrency and late producers are not executed. Empty hash buckets are set up by fixture, not native peer list init. Failure children intentionally retain unfinished resources until process exit; QDF_BUG is a controlled model endpoint. Only private qualified parent-shutdown sequences are selected; no shared live PSOC teardown authority, native attach/detach hardening, active START/UP SSR, backend activation, phone/firmware/RF or AirDrop certification.

native-psoc-lease.limitations: Fixture caller integration only, no production kernel changes or automatic shutdown coordinator. PSOC storage and final destroy/free remain static modeled endpoints; native PSOC create, real PSOC component teardown, PSOC peer/VDEV attachment references and actual PSOC heap free are not executed. Native PDEV create/real components and DP producer/completion graph retain 0093 model boundaries. PSOC locking/atomic operations and map capacity are fixture choices (capacity 1 from target Kbuild default, not a full target-config or multi-radio certification). Native PSOC attach does not itself gate logical deletion and native detach does not authenticate a valid slot owner; only an owned, serialized map contract is selected, not a production fix. Global late producers, platform kworker concurrency, active START/UP SSR, backend activation, phone/firmware/RF and AirDrop remain unverified. Failure children retain unfinished resources until process exit.

prior_failed_attempts.cause: New fixture lookup-policy assertion mixed OR and AND without explicit grouping; -Werror=parentheses rejected host C compilation. Grouping corrected; original native bodies unchanged.

Normal contracts passed, but the omitted bus-stop mutation left hif_sc unused and -Werror rejected mutation compilation. Mutations now explicitly consume unused locals so behavioral assertions can reject them.
